sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the applicability structure while preserving the prior valid instructions: the applicable branch currently makes platingHullAreaClassification, framingAngleOmega, platingSupportedByStructuralMember, and iceLoadRequiredNetPlateThickness conjunctively mandatory, and the separate I2_022_PlatingShape target makes all of them unconditionally mandatory. Encode the alternatives as applicable iff hull area is one of BI_b, M_b, or S_b and Omega >= 70 degrees, versus non-applicable iff Omega < 70 degrees or the hull area is outside those values. Do not require both alternatives or impose these properties unconditionally on every plating.
